notes.title: New pricing and Steam Deck compatibility.
notes.content:
Due to a change in Steam's pricing policy, it has been decided to set prices for all games and DLC to $0.99. All future products will also be released at this price (if there are no new surprises).

Also today, games 5.0 and 6.0 were tested and received official Steam Deck support.
